sethsreviews/the-invite-2026.text: A melting pot of awkwardness and revelation. Feels so intimate, capturing these little residual pieces of love in a withering marriage - often using seriously great mirrored images to further the hidden barriers. Walks a tightrope with such precision. Has some of the best blocking you’ll see in years.

georgecarmi/the-odyssey-2026.text: i wish i had something more meaningful to say right now, but i am at a major loss for words. several instances i found my body having a physical reaction to the pure filmmaking magic that i was experiencing. my eyes watered, my body began shaking, and i could feel an overwhelming visceral reaction consume me as ludwig göransson’s poetic composition flowed through my being. christopher nolan, thank you for making a film of such sheer ambition.
